metadata.description: Kanōn: a ticket-driven, verifier-backed engineering standard, split by stack so each repo loads only the rules it uses.

plugins.name: kanon-core
plugins.description: Engineering standard core: execution discipline, implementer/design/review/failure-mode agents, ADRs, guard hooks, Serena MCP. Enable in every repo.

plugins.name: kanon-java
plugins.description: Java discipline for Quarkus or Spring Boot: rules, quarkus-reviewer and spring-reviewer agents. Enable in Java repos.

plugins.name: kanon-java-airails
plugins.description: Opt-in Adam Bien airails skills: BCE, MicroProfile, Java 25 conventions, system tests, sbce. Enable in Java repos that use them.

plugins.name: kanon-ts
plugins.description: TypeScript + NestJS discipline: rules, nestjs-boundary-reviewer agent. Enable in TS backend repos.

plugins.name: kanon-web
plugins.description: Frontend discipline: web rules and router skill. Enable in frontend repos.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, context size, rate limits, session cost, cold-cache cost, and one-click handoff. Needs a Claude Code build with hooks modules.

plugins.name: collision-guard
plugins.description: Warns before editing a file another Claude Code session in the same folder changed recently, and shows what the other sessions are working on. Needs a Claude Code build with hooks modules.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: rewrite the draft as a sharper prompt and wrap it in your standing template (~/.claude/prompt-templates). Needs a Claude Code build with hooks modules.
